Camera-device page tables in devicemanager.so
Each table is 192 bytes = 6 pages x 32 one-byte registers; page p register r
is at table[p*32 + r].  SetupScanner::SetCameraResolution() writes pages 0..5
of one camera from one table (bRequest 0xe0, wValue=0, wLength=32 per page).
